book.title: With a Tangled Skein (Incarnations of Immortality, #3)
book.description: Weaver Niobe 21 learns to love husband Cedric 16, until he dies in her place - a plot of Satan. In revenge, she takes job as Clothos, youngest aspect of Fate, shares minds with Lachesis and Atropos. To save her son the Magician and grand-daughter Luna, she navigates a maze in Hell of 100 illusions and monsters, with 100 reality threads. Author's Note 24-pg, bio 1-pg.
